name: Notion
summary: Pages, docs and databases in a shared workspace.

flows.title: Create a page
steps: Click the new page icon at the top of the left sidebar. In the desktop app, cmd/ctrl + N does the same.
The new page opens. Type the page's title at the top.
Start writing in the body of the page.

flows.title: Find a page
steps: Click Search in the sidebar, or press cmd/ctrl + P.
Type the words to look for. Put a phrase in quotes to match it exactly.
Pick the page from the results. Recently viewed pages are listed first, and the sort and filter options narrow the list.

flows.title: Share a page with someone
steps: Open the page and click Share at the top.
Enter a workspace member's name or a guest's email address.
Choose their permission level from the menu beside their name: Full access, Can edit, Can comment or Can view.
